description: React component for rendering various form fields in Mattermost apps, including text, select, date, datetime, boolean, and markdown fields, with support for validation, help text, and external integrations.

classes.name: AppsFormField
classes.description: React component class for rendering dynamic form fields based on field type, handling user interactions, and displaying help/error messages.

methods.name: handleSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of options in select-type fields, updating the parent component via onChange.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the appropriate form field component based on the field type, including text, select, date, datetime, bool, radio, and markdown.
